zh_CN: 初雪落下了，冬天到了。农场也安静下来。
en: The first snow fell. Winter has come.

zh_CN: 镇公所送来了丰收的谢礼 {money}G
en: The town hall sent {money}G for the good harvest

zh_CN: 书雅带了几本书来，想和你聊聊。
en: Shuyai brought some books and wants to talk.
The mayor sent a {money}G summer grant

zh_CN: 一位旅人路过农场，留下 {money}G 谢礼
en: A traveler passed the farm and left {money}G

zh_CN: 传说中用来求婚的信物，送给心爱的人。
en: A legendary token used to propose to your beloved.

zh_CN: 对着水面按空格抛竿，咬钩时再按一次收竿
en: Pull it out at the water and reel in on the bite

zh_CN: 用来翻地，把草地变成可耕种的土地。
清除枯死的作物，也可以割草。
en: Clears withered crops and cuts weeds.

zh_CN: 给作物浇水，作物才会生长。
en: Waters crops so they keep growing.
Clears a swath in one swing
Frees gold ore over a wider area

zh_CN: 书雅想和你聊聊最近读的书。
en: Shuyai wants to talk about what you have been reading.

zh_CN: 书雅留了张纸条，约你傍晚去图书馆。
en: Shuyai left a note asking you to the library at dusk.

zh_CN: 花婆婆特意留了一束花给你。
en: The florist saved a bouquet just for you.

zh_CN: 花婆婆说，想让你看看她最宝贝的角落。
en: The florist wants to show you her dearest corner.

zh_CN: 渔夫约你去码头看日出。
en: The fisher invites you to the dock for sunrise.

zh_CN: 渔夫说要带你去一个只有他知道的地方。
en: The fisher wants to take you somewhere only he knows.

zh_CN: 铁匠塞给你一件小东西，转身继续打铁。
en: The blacksmith shoves a little gift at you and turns back to the anvil.

zh_CN: 铁匠说，想请你帮他挑一块好铁。
en: The blacksmith asks you to help pick good iron.

zh_CN: 累计出货 50 件，把修路的钱攒出来。
en: Ship 50 items in total to fund the roads.

zh_CN: 让图鉴发现 20 种道具，书架上就有新书了。
en: Discover 20 kinds of items to fill the shelves.

zh_CN: 学会 5 道食谱，顺便解开南瓜派的做法。
en: Learn 5 recipes to unlock Pumpkin Pie.

zh_CN: 累计赚到 5000G，商队就愿意常来。
en: Earn 5000G in total to keep the caravans coming.

zh_CN: 参加 4 场不同的节日，顺便解开金枪鱼刺身的做法。
en: Join 4 different festivals to unlock Tuna Sashimi.
